pages.name: Natural bamboo fence roll
supplier: F/第一 Natural bamboo fencing
F/第二 Giant natural bamboo fencing
F/第三 Natural bamboo fence with vanish lacquer
pages.facts: Round natural (yellow) bamboo canes, galvanised iron wire. Diameters 14-20mm (2400 m2 per 40HC), 20-30mm (2300 m2/40HC), 30-35mm (2100 m2/40HC). Roll sizes WxH (m): 2.5x1, 2.5x1.5, 1.8x1.8, 2.5x1.8, 1.8x2, 2.5x2, 2.5x2.5. Big diameters 35-40/40-50mm can be bound with wire, a bamboo pole or nylon wire ('giant' version). Optional varnish lacquer finish. QC: moisture content measured ~7.8-11.9% before shipping; diameters checked with tape. QC sizes photographed: 100x180, 150x180, 180x180, 200x180, 250x180 cm. Packing photos exist.

pages.name: Natural black bamboo fence roll
supplier: F/第四 Natural black bamboo fencing
pages.facts: Round natural black bamboo canes (colour is the bamboo's own, not paint), galvanised wire. Same size table as natural: diameters 14-20 (2400 m2/40HC), 20-30 (2300), 30-35mm (2100); rolls WxH 2.5x1, 2.5x1.5, 1.8x1.8, 2.5x1.8, 1.8x2, 2.5x2, 2.5x2.5 m. QC sizes photographed: 100x180 to 250x180 cm.

pages.name: Carbonized bamboo fence
supplier: F/第七 Carbonized camel brown bamboo fence varnish lacquer
F/第八 Cheapest carbonized bamboo fence with vanish lacquer
pages.facts: Heat-treated (carbonized) bamboo. Two grades: carbonized light/camel brown, 20-30mm, 2300 m2 per 40HC, varnish lacquer; budget carbonized dark black, 10-20mm, 2600 m2 per 40HC, varnish lacquer. Rolls WxH 2.5x1, 2.5x1.5, 1.8x1.8, 2.5x1.8, 1.8x2, 2.5x2, 2.5x2.5 m. Galvanised wire.

pages.name: Mahogany bamboo fence roll
supplier: F/第九 Red bamboo fence mahogany
pages.facts: Red / mahogany colour, dyed. 20-30mm, 2300 m2 per 40HC. Rolls WxH 2.5x1, 2.5x1.5, 1.8x1.8, 2.5x1.8, 1.8x2, 2.5x2, 2.5x2.5 m. Galvanised wire.

pages.name: Tonkin bamboo screen
supplier: P/第十一 Natural tonkin bamboo screen
P/第十二 Carbonized tonkin bamboo screen
pages.facts: Folding room-divider screen: three hinged panels of natural tonkin bamboo poles in a wood frame. W120 x T5 x H180 cm, net weight 22 kg, packed in plastic foam + pallet. Natural and carbonized versions. Tonkin: one of the strongest, most flexible bamboo species, naturally bitter so less attractive to insects; poles grown 3+ years.

pages.name: Natural bamboo edging
supplier: F/第十 Natural bamboo boarder edging
pages.facts: Rolled border edging of natural yellow bamboo, 35/40mm canes, tops cut and capped at the nodes, drilled and strung on hidden galvanised wire, bends to any shape. Widths 100/120/150/180/200 cm; heights 20/30/35/40/45 cm. Used for beds, walkways, landscaping projects. Also available carbonized.
